engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Electronic Steering Column Lock (ESCL) not operational
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Electronic Steering Column Lock (ESCL)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C): Immobilizer, check/Değiştirin / Yenileyin: Electronic Steering Column Lock (ESCL) per TPI 2022458 as well as 2023556 (RoW) or Campaign 48I5 (NAR).
When found after  16-Steering Wheel Kontrol Modülü replacement make sure the incorrect module was not installed.
